national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu to confer Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025-26
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu confers the Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025-26, celebrating the achievements of India's cleanest cities under the Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban led by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.

The 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan was organized under the theme 'Swachhata Ki Nayi Pehel- Badhayein Haath, Karein Safai Saath', evaluating Urban Local Bodies across 43 indicators in 10 assessment areas.

The survey initiative has expanded from covering 73 Urban Local Bodies in 2016 to over 4,000 cities in its latest edition, incorporating key focuses on Urban River Fronts, school behavior change, and waste management.

national_news.title: Government Launches Applications for PLI-MD 2.0 for Medical Devices
bullets: The Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers has invited fresh applications under the Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Medical Devices (PLI-MD 2.0), extending the scheme up to 2035-36 with a outlay of ₹2,700 crore.
The revised scheme allows applicants three years to establish manufacturing facilities across four target segments, including high-end medical devices, critical components, and medical implants.
Key reforms in PLI-MD 2.0 include the removal of the minimum sales threshold, reduction in minimum investment requirements, and simplified incentive claim procedures to boost domestic manufacturing.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Directs WhatsApp and Intermediaries to Curb Digital Arrest Scams
bullets: The Supreme Court directed WhatsApp and other digital intermediaries to submit proposed preventive measures against digital arrest scams to the Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C).

The bench, hearing a suo motu case titled ‘Victims of Digital Arrest Related to Forged Documents’, emphasized that financial institutions and banks must be held accountable and compensate victims if fraud occurs due to a lack of due diligence.
State and Union Territory law enforcement agencies were ordered to submit detailed reports on FIRs and ongoing investigations related to digital arrest scams.

national_news.title: BCCI Announces India Women's Squads for All-Format Tour of South Africa
bullets: The BCCI Women’s Selection Committee announced squads for the upcoming all-format tour of South Africa scheduled for December.
Smriti Mandhana will lead the Indian team across all three formats (one Test, three ODIs, and three T20Is).
Deepti Sharma has been named vice-captain for the Test and ODI squads, while Shafali Verma will serve as vice-captain for the T20I format.

national_news.title: Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 Promotes Artisans from Disadvantaged Communities at Dilli Haat
bullets: The ongoing Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 at Dilli Haat recorded cumulative sales of approximately ₹55.46 lakh between November 1 and 8.

Organised by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, the 15-day fair provides a platform for artisans from Scheduled Castes (SCs), Other Backward Classes (OBCs), Safai Karamcharis, and persons with disabilities.

Four participating corporations—NSFDC, NBCFDC, NSKFDC, and NDFDC—facilitated the event, featuring over 130 stalls across seven thematic zones under the theme ‘प्रकाश और परंपरा – ज्योति से ज्योति जलाएँ’.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Develop ₹1.21 Lakh Crore Hajipur-Gaya Industrial Corridor and 5-District Defence Corridor
bullets: The Bihar government announced the development of an industrial corridor spanning 1,650 acres between Hajipur and Gaya, starting at Rajapakar in Vaishali, with an estimated investment proposal of ₹1.21 lakh crore.

A dedicated Defence Corridor will be established across five districts: Munger, Kaimur, Jamui, Banka, and Arwal to manufacture weapons including fighter jet parts, drones, artillery guns, and small arms.

The state currently operates an Ordnance Factory in Nalanda producing the Bi-Modular Charge System (BMCS) for artillery, while Munger retains its historical gun manufacturing identity dating back to 1760.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Hikes DA/DR and Approves Startup & Fellowship Schemes for Female Students
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved a 3% increase in Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR) under the 7th Pay Commission (from 60% to 63%), alongside hikes for 6th and 5th Pay Commission structures effective July 1, 2026.
Approved the 'Bihar Ki Beti Startup Challenge Scheme' with an outlay of ₹88.20 crore (2026-30) to foster entrepreneurship among up to 2,100 female college students.

Sanctioned the 'Mukhyamantri Balika PhD Fellowship Scheme' to encourage women's participation in higher research, and extended the Modified Assured Career Progression (MACP) Scheme to regular urban local body employees.

bihar_news.title: Patna Municipal Corporation Lists ₹200-Crore Municipal Bonds on NSE
bullets: Patna Municipal Corporation (PMC) officially listed its ₹200-crore municipal bond on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), becoming the first civic body in Bihar to access market-based urban financing.
The state announced plans to expand Patna's Marine Drive from 26 km to 126 km with a proposed investment of ₹30,000 crore under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.
The government highlighted urban development plans including 12 greenfield satellite townships like Pataliputra Township and financial support of up to ₹98,000 for 3-kW rooftop solar installations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Launches Ganga Water Metro Service in Patna
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister launched a catamaran water metro service on the Ganga river operating between Digha Ghat and Gandhi Ghat in Patna, with plans for extension to Kangan Ghat.
The service utilizes a 50-seater hybrid electric-powered vessel designed to reduce pollution and provide an alternative transit route to the congested Ashok Rajpath.
The state tourism department initiative sets the single adult fare at ₹50, offering fast and shore charging facilities at the terminal ghats.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM suspends 15 officials over public grievance negligence under Sahyog Programme
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary suspended 15 officers and staff members immediately for failing to ensure timely disposal of public grievance applications under the Sahyog Programme.
Departmental proceedings were ordered against the suspended officials for procedural delays and poor quality of application disposal.
The statewide Sahyog Camp initiative, launched in May, organizes panchayat-wise camps on the first and third Tuesdays of every month with a mandate to resolve applications within 30 days.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to host Global Convention on Transforming Bihar 2027 in Patna
bullets: The two-day 'Global Convention on Transforming Bihar 2027' is scheduled for January 12-13, 2027, in Patna to draft an economic transformation roadmap.
The event is jointly organized by the Institute for Human Development (IHD) and Bihar Foundation in collaboration with Nalanda University.
The convention will gather 1,500 experts, policymakers, and global diaspora across seven plenary sessions and 10 thematic panel discussions covering agriculture, investments, AI, and tourism.

bihar_news.title: Eight infrastructure funds bid for NHAI highway monetisation bundles in Bihar
bullets: Eight infrastructure funds and companies submitted bids for the 90.6 km Purnea-Dalkhola-Raiganj section of NH-27 under NHAI's Toll-Operate-Transfer (ToT) Bundle 22.
Bids were also received for Bundle 20 (Muzaffarpur-Darbhanga-Asanpur section, 145.6 km) and Bundle 21 (Asanpur-Forbesganj-Purnea section, 139.3 km) in Bihar.
Under the ToT model, successful bidders receive toll collection and highway operations rights for 20 years in exchange for an upfront payment.

bihar_news.title: 19-km Kacchi Dargah-Bidupur Six-Lane Ganga Bridge Set for Inauguration
bullets: The 19-km Kacchi Dargah-Bidupur six-lane bridge across the Ganga River will connect Kacchi Dargah in Patna district with Bidupur in Vaishali district.
The major infrastructure project comprises a 9-km main cable-stayed bridge over the river along with approach roads to strengthen north-south road connectivity.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the bridge and also visit the Jafarpatti Industrial Area in Rajapakar block of Vaishali district.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Launch Voluntary 'Give It Up' Electricity Subsidy Drive
bullets: The Bihar government will launch a voluntary 'Give It Up' campaign on December 1 to urge affluent residents and income-tax payers to surrender their monthly free power subsidy.
Under the Mukhyamantri Vidyut Upbhokta Sahayata Yojana, households currently receive up to 125 units of free electricity per month, covering nearly 1.92 crore families.
The scheme costs the state exchequer around Rs 23,000 crore annually (approx. Rs 10,000 per family), and redirected savings will fund state educational infrastructure.
